run_ident_cli_by_serial: run the ident CLI tool to send an identification message to a Digit360 device by serial number
run_ident_cli_by_tty: run the ident CLI tool to send an identification message to a Digit360 device by tty path
run_ident_list_devices: run the ident CLI tool with the list flag to query and print all connected Digit360 devices
review_main_function: review the main function that parses CLI args, connects to a Digit360 device, and sends a status message
review_cfg_dataclass: review the cfg dataclass that defines CLI arguments for serial number, tty, and list options
